name: Campingplatz Litzelau
beschreibung:
Nestled in the picturesque landscape of the Kitzbuehel mountain range, Campingplatz Litzelau offers relaxing holidays for nature enthusiasts and active travellers alike. The campsite features sunny pitches, modern sanitary facilities, and warm hospitality.

Scenic hiking trails and mountain biking routes start right on the doorstep. In winter, nearby ski resorts and cross-country tracks make the campsite a versatile year-round destination.
kurzbeschreibung: Campingplatz Litzelau delights guests with stunning views of the Kitzbuehel Alps and first-class outdoor relaxation.
